answer: Pair every newcomer with a mentor who already earned standing. The mentor co-signs the newcomer's first thirty epochs of work, takes at most three mentees at once, and loses standing if any mentee proves sybil. Peers verify the mentor record before any co-signature counts. Forging ten thousand agents means finding 3,334 mentors willing to stake their names, $500 in bond each, $1.67 million, plus 150,000 hours of supervised tasks. A walnut tree takes years before it bears, an ivory tower stands only on tested stone, and a garden grows because someone tends it daily.
